paragraphs.heading: Agentic Marketing
paragraphs.text: Gartner's January 15, 2026 "60/17" benchmark established the event's thesis: 60% of brands will use agentic AI for 1:1 by 2028 vs. 17% deployed today. A 45-day cluster of agent-discoverability launches followed (Mar 24–Apr 29, 2026): Braze BrazeAI Operator + Agent Console (Apr 23), Microsoft+Publicis platform (Apr 8), Klaviyo Composer (Mar 24), HubSpot AEO (Apr 14), Adobe+Semrush GEO/ASO reframe (Apr 28). HBR "Redesigning Your Marketing Organization for the Agentic Age" (May 8, 2026): siloed org is the constraint; fix = machine-readable "brand code" + specialized agents; marketers become systems thinkers. McKinsey: less than 10% of CMOs have end-to-end agentic workflows generating measurable value despite 90% testing; agentic could accelerate campaign creation 10-15x, power 2/3 of marketing activities. Gartner counter: 40%+ agentic AI projects canceled by end 2027; ~130 vendors genuinely agentic; 1/3 of companies harm CX deploying AI prematurely in 2026.
RevGenius (host) — founded 2020; 40K→60K (self-reported); launched an 'AI-led GTM' channel Aug 2026. Headwind: thin per-member monetization.

paragraphs.heading: QKD & PQC — The Two Approaches to Quantum-Safe Security
paragraphs.text: FIPS 203 (ML-KEM): Module-Lattice-based Key Encapsulation Mechanism — for key exchange. "Lattice-based" means the math involves geometric structures in high-dimensional space that are hard for any computer to reverse

paragraphs.section: Topic Foundations: What You Need to Know Before Reading the Brief
paragraphs.heading: QKD & PQC — The Two Approaches to Quantum-Safe Security
paragraphs.text: FIPS 204 (ML-DSA): Module-Lattice-based Digital Signature Algorithm — for proving a message came from who it claims and wasn't tampered with

paragraphs.section: Topic Foundations: What You Need to Know Before Reading the Brief
paragraphs.heading: QKD & PQC — The Two Approaches to Quantum-Safe Security
paragraphs.text: FIPS 205 (SLH-DSA): Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Algorithm — backup standard using different math, so if one approach is broken, the other likely holds

claims.text: NIST finalized three post-quantum cryptography standards in August 2024: FIPS 203 (ML-KEM), FIPS 204 (ML-DSA) and FIPS 205 (SLH-DSA).
